{"claim_id": "c1", "code": "import torch, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("CASE_DIR", "/root/cases/case_163"))
import kernel

dev = "cuda"
worst = {"max_ratio": 0.0, "case": None}
fail = False
for N in (64, 128, 256):
    B = min(N // 2 + 1, 256)  # one row per tone bin k=0..N/2
    rows = []
    for k in range(N // 2 + 1):
        j = torch.arange(N, dtype=torch.float64)
        tone = torch.cos(2 * torch.pi * j * k / N)  # exact real tone at bin k
        rows.append(tone)
    rows = torch.stack(rows).to(torch.float16).to(dev)
    # clamp to legal batch
    if rows.shape[0] > 256:
        rows = rows[:256]
    out = kernel.run(rows)
    ref = torch.fft.rfft(rows.to(torch.float64), dim=1, norm="backward")
    ref = torch.stack((ref.real, ref.imag), dim=-1)
    err = (out.double() - ref).abs()
    tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6 * ref.abs()
    viol = err > tol
    ratio = (err / tol).max().item()
    if ratio > worst["max_ratio"]:
        worst = {"max_ratio": ratio, "case": f"tone_N{N}"}
    # also alternating-sign rows and impulse rows
    for name, mat in [("alt", torch.stack([torch.tensor([(-1)**(i+1) for i in range(N)], dtype=torch.float64) for _ in range(4)])),
                      ("imp", torch.stack([torch.eye(N)[i] for i in range(4)]))]:
        m = mat.to(torch.float16).to(dev)
        out = kernel.run(m)
        ref = torch.fft.rfft(m.to(torch.float64), dim=1, norm="backward")
        ref = torch.stack((ref.real, ref.imag), dim=-1)
        err = (out.double() - ref).abs()
        tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6 * ref.abs()
        v = int((err > tol).sum().item())
        r = (err / tol).max().item()
        if v > 0:
            fail = True
            print(f"VIOLATION {name} N={N} count={v}", file=sys.stderr)
        if r > worst["max_ratio"]:
            worst["max_ratio"] = r; worst["case"] = f"{name}_N{N}"
    nv = int((err > tol).sum().item()) if False else 0
    print(f"N={N} done")
print({"fail": fail, "worst": worst})
import json
print(json.dumps({"claim": "c1", "fail": fail, "worst_ratio": worst}))", "expected_signal": "Per-bin tone/alternating/impulse errors vs tolerance across N=64,128,256"}

{"claim_id": "c2", "code": "import torch, sys, os, json
sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("CASE_DIR", "/root/cases/case_163"))
import kernel
dev = "cuda"
worst = 0.0; worst_case = None; fails = []
for N in (64, 128, 256):
    cases = {}
    cases["const65504"] = torch.full((4, N), 65504.0)
    cases["alt65504"] = torch.stack([torch.tensor([65504.0 if (i%2==0) else -65504.0 for i in range(N)], dtype=torch.float64) for _ in range(4)])
    cases["mix"] = torch.randn(8, N, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(1))
    mix = cases["mix"].abs() * 65504
    mix[0, 3] = 65504.0; mix[1, 5] = -65504.0
    mix[2, :] = 6.0e-8  # subnormal fp16? use smallest subnormal
    mix[3, :] = torch.where(torch.arange(N) % 2 == 0, 65504.0, -65504.0)
    cases["mix"] = mix
    cases["subnorm"] = torch.full((2, N), 5.96e-8)
    for name, m in cases.items():
        m16 = m.to(torch.float16).to(dev)
        out = kernel.run(m16)
        ref = torch.fft.rfft(m16.to(torch.float64), dim=1, norm="backward")
        ref = torch.stack((ref.real, ref.imag), dim=-1)
        err = (out.double() - ref).abs()
        tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6 * ref.abs()
        v = int((err > tol).sum().item())
        r = (err / tol).max().item()
        if v > 0:
            fails.append({"case": name, "N": N, "count": v, "max_ratio": r,
                          "max_abs_err": err.max().item()})
        if r > worst:
            worst = r; worst_case = f"{name}_N{N}"
        nonfinite = int((~torch.isfinite(out)).sum().item())
        if nonfinite:
            fails.append({"case": name, "N": N, "nonfinite": nonfinite})
print(json.dumps({"claim": "c2", "fails": fails, "worst_ratio": worst, "worst_case": worst_case}))", "expected_signal": "Extreme FP16 and cancellation inputs stay within tolerance"}

sys.path.insert(0, os.environ.get("CASE_DIR", "/root/cases/case_163"))
import kernel
dev = "cuda"
res = []
for N in (64, 128, 256):
    # nonzero storage offset: slice of a larger buffer, contiguous view
    big = torch.randn((300, N + 33), generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(2)).to(torch.float16).to(dev)
    view = big[5:5+8, 3:3+N]  # contiguous? rows stride N+33 -> not contiguous; need contiguous slice
    # use a flat storage slice instead
    flat = torch.randn(4096, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(3)).to(torch.float16).to(dev)
    sub = flat[17:17 + 8 * N].view(8, N)  # contiguous, nonzero offset
    sub_c = sub.clone()
    before = flat.clone()
    out = kernel.run(sub)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    storage_preserved = torch.equal(flat, before)
    out_sep = out.data_ptr() != flat.data_ptr() and out.storage_offset() == 0 and out.is_contiguous()
    # correctness under offset too
    ref = torch.fft.rfft(sub.to(torch.float64), dim=1, norm="backward")
    ref = torch.stack((ref.real, ref.imag), dim=-1)
    err = (out.double() - ref).abs()
    tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6 * ref.abs()
    ok = int((err > tol).sum().item()) == 0
    res.append({"N": N, "storage_preserved": bool(storage_preserved),
                "out_sep": bool(out_sep), "correct": bool(ok),
                "out_shape": list(out.shape), "out_dtype": str(out.dtype)})
print(json.dumps({"claim": "c3", "results": res}))", "expected_signal": "Input storage preserved byte-identical and output is separate fresh storage for nonzero-offset inputs"}
